messages:
Ashley Park: Hi team! I'm Ashley — joined today as a backend infra engineer. Quick Qs: my laptop arrived but I'm blocked on SSH to the repo, and I don't have access to the Dedicated cluster yet. Also — where do I grab stickers? :grin:
Maria Gonzalez: Welcome Ashley!! :tada: I pinged SRE to add you to the GitHub org and Dedicated group. For SSH, try adding your public key at https://internal.redwood/onboard/ssh and then ping @Devon if it still fails.
Devon Li: hey @Ashley Park — I can pair on SSH in ~10m. If you want, paste your public key here or DM me. Also, Dedicated access usually needs the access request ticket + approvals; I'll follow up with security.
Katie (People Ops): Welcome! I received your onboarding forms. NDA is in the system so I'm kicking off the access requests now — should see emails in 30–60m. LMK if anything times out.
onboard-bot: Device enrollment complete for ashley.park (MDM).
Lucas Reed: welcome! team lunch tomorrow at 12:30 — what do you like? we do a casual intro after standup. Added you to the calendar invite.
Ashley Park: Thanks all — I love bahn mi and poké bowls. Fun fact: I used to run a small ramen pop-up on weekends. Ok two truths & a lie: I can juggle, I've lived in 4 countries, I'm allergic to coffee.
Maria Gonzalez: stickers — I brought a small stash. laptop decals, infrastructure pack, or cute animals? what do you want? :sticker-star:
Devon Li: if SSH is still failing, try running this locally and paste output here:
```
ssh -T git@github.com -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
```
I can hop on Zoom if it still borks.
Lucas Reed: standup at 10:15 if you want to do a quick hello. Also FYI we'll pair you with a buddy (assigned: Devon) for the first week.
Ashley Park: cool, dropping my pubkey now. thanks everyone! excited to be here :smile:
